title: Apparel and footwear returns
text: Apparel and footwear may be returned within 7 days of delivery when the item is unused, unwashed, and has its original tags attached. Size or fit issues are eligible when the item passes the condition check.

title: Electronics returns
text: Electronics generally have a 7-day replacement window for eligible manufacturing defects. Replacement requires the product, accessories, and packaging to be available for verification.

title: Home returns
text: Eligible home products may be returned within 10 days of delivery if they are unused and in resalable condition. Large or assembled items can require an inspection before reverse pickup is approved.

title: COD refunds
text: For a cash-on-delivery order, an approved refund is processed to the bank account or payment destination confirmed during the refund workflow. Bank processing can take 5 to 7 business days after the refund is initiated.

title: Delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery is normally completed within 3 to 7 business days after dispatch. Remote locations and exceptional logistics events can extend the estimated delivery date.

title: Reverse pickup eligibility
text: Reverse pickup is available when the order is return-eligible and the pickup location is serviceable. The item must meet the applicable condition requirements before pickup is confirmed.

title: Size exchange
text: Eligible apparel and footwear can be exchanged for another available size during the applicable return window. The original item must satisfy the same condition checks used for a return.

title: Damaged item
text: A visibly damaged item should be reported as soon as possible after delivery. Keep the packaging and product photographs available because they may be requested during verification.

title: Missing accessories
text: For products with bundled accessories, return or replacement review can require all included accessories. Missing components may delay or affect eligibility after inspection.

title: Return condition
text: Returned products should be unused, undamaged, and complete with original packaging, labels, manuals, and accessories when applicable. Final eligibility is determined during the return inspection.

title: Refund after pickup
text: For a return that requires reverse pickup, the refund process begins after the returned item passes the required verification. The final credit time depends on the payment method and banking network.

title: Cancellation before dispatch
text: An order can generally be cancelled before it enters dispatch processing. Once dispatch has started, cancellation may no longer be available and the customer may need to use the return process after delivery.

title: Non-returnable products
text: Certain hygiene-sensitive, personalized, or otherwise restricted products may be non-returnable. The product page's return eligibility information takes precedence for such items.

title: Pickup attempts
text: A reverse pickup may be rescheduled when the first attempt fails for a serviceable address. Customers should keep the package ready and accessible for the next scheduled attempt.
